# Mulham Ibrahim — Digital Studio & Creative Engineering

> Mulham Ibrahim is an independent Creative Developer, UI/UX Designer, and Digital Experience Architect. Founder of Plasma Agency, delivering bespoke digital brand systems, immersive WebGL/GSAP interactive websites, and conversion-focused web applications for forward-thinking brands worldwide.

## Key Information
- **Founder**: Mulham Ibrahim (Founder of Plasma Agency)
- **Primary Specializations**: Creative Development, UI/UX Design, Brand Identity Systems, Modern Frontend Engineering
- **Location**: Damascus, Syria (Available Worldwide for remote consulting and client work)
- **Website**: https://mulham.design
- **Primary Tech Stack**: JavaScript (ES6+), GSAP (GreenSock), Swiper, HTML5/CSS3, Python, Node.js, WebGL, TailwindCSS, Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud
- **Email Contact**: mulhamlol790@gmail.com
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mulham-ibrahim-2021643ab
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/creative_mulham/

## Core Services
- **Creative Web Development**: High-performance, motion-driven websites with bespoke typography, sub-16ms micro-interactions, and accessible architecture.
- **UI/UX & Experience Architecture**: User-centric interfaces, interactive prototypes, design systems, and conversion-rate-optimized digital funnels.
- **Brand Identity & Systems**: Cohesive visual identity, typography guidelines, design tokens, and digital brand presence.
- **Frontend Performance & SEO**: 60fps animations, structured JSON-LD schema, Core Web Vitals optimization, and AI Search Engine Optimization (AEO).
